reason: The cited evidence shows γ′ precipitation strengthening in Ni-Co-Fe-based HEAs with Al and Ti additions, but none of the studies involve a Ti–Ni primary matrix. The specific claim that Al alone (with reduced Cr) induces γ′ in a Ti35Ni35 matrix and the quantified strength increase at 800°C are unsupported extrapolations from different alloy systems.
premises: Al addition to a Ti–Ni primary HEA can induce coherent γ′ nanoprecipitates
These γ′ precipitates will be of type Ni₃Ti or a related ordered phase with Al contributions
The coherent γ′ nanoprecipitates will provide precipitation strengthening at elevated temperatures
A 5 at% Al addition will yield a ~20–30% increase in yield strength at ~800°C relative to the baseline
